relations: Kayla 与 Vero 是朋友：Kayla 说“I’m more than happy to be his friend”“I love the way his mind works, and I admire the freedom of saying what he thinks and feels without filtering himself.”
Kayla 与 Clay 处于敌对：她要求 Vero 必须叫上 Clay，“Please make sure Clay is there—his ass is mine. I plan to make sure I aim for that fucker’s neck.”
Clay 与 Vero 是同一阵营的同伴：Clay 说“It was either wait there with him or come get you”，并与 Vero 为赌注斗嘴，“Clay, you owe me twenty dollars.”/“I don’t owe you shit.”

Ares 与 Kayla 是给予装备者与被观察者的关系：Ares 递给她枪并注视她，“Ares appears from inside the gates and hands me a paintball gun.”“He is watching me the way he did previously, like he wants to deconstruct me from the inside out.”
Nixie 与 Vero 是同一展览的同事：Vero 跟她打赌“a graveyard smoothie”，她负责安全简报并给 Kayla“a two-minute head start”。

facts.fact: 两周以来 Clay 在 Kayla 每个班次都出现在酒吧，却只在她到店和点单时点一下头；她问过 Rogue 是不是她把班表告诉了他，Rogue 说没有。
facts.anchor: Clay comes to the bar every time I have a shift. I asked Rogue if she told him when I work, but she didn’t, so I don’t know how he knows.

facts.fact: Rogue 警告 Vero 不要在 Kayla 上班时招惹她，Vero 于是改为跟着她、帮她收杯子送回吧台；Kayla 承认自己已经很喜欢他。
facts.anchor: Vero, however, has been warned by Rogue not to annoy me while I am working. He follows me around and talks, or collects glasses and brings them back to the bar.

facts.fact: Vero 送来神秘箱子，Kayla 当晚七点拆开，里面是迷彩裤、深绿背心和迷彩油彩；她随后 FaceTime 给 Vero。
facts.anchor: I undo the huge-ass bow on the top and drag off the lid. Inside is a pair of camo pants, a dark-green tank top, and camo face paint.

facts.fact: Vero 说明这是新技术展览的试运行：他靠赢下喝墓地奶昔的赌约才拿到第一场追逐战资格，武器是彩弹枪或凝胶枪，首轮主题为军事。
facts.anchor: We have a new exhibit opening tonight for a trial run. I bet Nixie I could drink a graveyard smoothie—she didn’t believe I could.

facts.fact: Kayla 答应回岛，条件是有枪并且 Clay 必须在场，她要瞄准 Clay 的脖子；Vero 保证会把 Clay 拉来。
facts.anchor: Then fuck yes, I’m in. Please make sure Clay is there—his ass is mine. I plan to make sure I aim for that fucker’s neck.”

facts.fact: 来接她的司机是 Clay 亲自开来的黑色皮卡，他嘴上不情愿，说 Vero 太吵、他说话比 Vero 少；Mabel 穿着睡衣开门担心并要拿枪。
facts.anchor: Because Vero is annoying as fuck and acting like an excited little squirrel. It was either wait there with him or come get you, and while I might not like you, you talk less than him.”

facts.fact: Ares 递枪后她朝 Clay 开了一枪故意打偏六英寸作为警告，Clay 连眼都没眨。
facts.anchor: The paintball cracks against a tree six inches to the left of his head.

facts.fact: 她爬上左角瞭望塔埋伏，一发彩弹正中 Clay 胸口；随即 Vero、Brawley、Ares 三人从背后用三把枪指住她并承认是设局引她入彀（Clay 因此又欠四十美元），Clay 随后一枪打中她肩膀，说“Now we’re even.”。
facts.anchor: He raises his gun and shoots me directly in the shoulder.
